long_biography.plain_text:
Lucas Silva helped develop LeVen Yachts around a practical design problem: combining shallow-water access with the comfort and engineering standards of a larger vessel. He worked with YachtCreators on the programme, while Vripack handled design and engineering. The resulting range incorporated protected propellers and batteries capable of supplying domestic power without running generators continuously.

His involvement also extended to the industry's relationship with its customers. An interview prepared for an international industry forum in 2019 explored his expectations of advisers and builders. Silva argued for expert guidance that respected the client's wishes, rather than allowing a supplier's preferences to dictate the project.
